raw:
The provided code does not adequately verify the dimensions of the input matrices. It correctly checks if the number of rows in the multiplier matches the number of columns in the multiplicand but fails to check if all rows in each matrix have consistent lengths. This can lead to index errors or incorrect results when the matrices are invalid. 

The error is caused by the absence of checks ensuring that each row in `multiplicand` has `n` elements and each row in `multiplier` has `p` elements.
